features:
Butter Fries — Potato Game Script
- Full Auto Farm — collects potatoes, peels, fries, collects cooked fries, and serves customers.
- One-Click Full Automation — enables production, upgrades, machines, perks, repairs, and progression.
- Auto Upgrades — tool capacity, peeling batch size, instant-peel unlock, cash boosts, and better tools.
- Auto Machine Purchases — selectable Conveyor, Robots, Auto Fryer, and Fries Shooter.
- Auto Power Repair — travels to the power box and completes cable connections during day or night.
- Auto Robot Repair — detects jammed robots and performs the repair interaction.
- Auto Fries Shooter Loading — loads carried fries when capacity is available.
- Machine Output Collection — recovers dropped production output, including finished fries stacks.
- Vacuum Support — collects loose food in batches and respects equipped-tool capacity.
- Auto Morning Perks — multiple preferred perks with an eligible-offer fallback.
- Threat Handling — possessed-customer shutter closure, reopening for normal customers, and emergency retreat.
- Night Protection — optional indoor behavior that pauses potato-pile trips.
- Auto Basement Progression — key collection, unlocking, and basement entry.
- Auto Teammate Rescue — attempts to help downed teammates when conditions permit.
- Auto Return to Lobby — requests a return after a completed or failed run.
- Teleport or Walk Travel — selectable travel modes.
- Crate Collection and Deposit — separate controls for taking and storing potatoes.
- Three Peel Modes — Fast, Scrub, and Instant; Instant requires the game unlock.
- Stockpile Controls — adjustable stock target with shared-food accounting and idle batch collection.
- Purchase Customization — cash reserve, purchase priorities, upgrade preferences, and machine selection.
- World ESP — anomaly, visiting-car, and dropped basement-key markers with distances.
- Pause and Resume — preserves enabled options, with optional pause on manual movement.
- Persistent Pause Banner — resume automation even while the main menu is hidden.
- Live Statistics — earnings per minute, session time, health, lives, inventory, stock, and action counters.
- Settings Save/Load — saves preferences when executor file functions are available.
- Anti-AFK
- Adjustable FPS Cap — 30–240 where supported.
- Automatic Retry and Recovery — cooldowns for rejected interactions and recovery from repeated worker errors.
- Individual Feature Toggles
- Seven-Tab GUI
- Left Shift Menu Toggle
- F8 Stop-All Hotkey
- GUI Unload and Re-execution Cleanup
